description: This file defines the CanonicalCookie class and related structures for managing HTTP cookies, including creation, validation, comparison, and attributes handling within the Chromium project.

classes.name: CanonicalCookie
classes.description: Represents a canonicalized HTTP cookie with attributes and methods for validation, comparison, and attribute access.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new CanonicalCookie from a cookie line, validating and canonicalizing inputs.

methods.name: CreateSanitizedCookie
methods.description: Creates a sanitized cookie based on input parameters, returning null if invalid.

methods.name: FromStorage
methods.description: Creates a CanonicalCookie from stored cookie properties, used for ingested cookies.

methods.name: CreateUnsafeCookieForTesting
methods.description: Creates a non-canonical cookie for testing purposes.

methods.name: IsCanonical
methods.description: Checks if the cookie is in a canonical form.

methods.name: IsCanonicalForFromStorage
methods.description: Checks if the cookie is valid for storage retrieval.

methods.name: IsEffectivelySameSiteNone
methods.description: Determines if the cookie's SameSite attribute is effectively 'None'.

methods.name: GetEffectiveSameSiteForTesting
methods.description: Returns the effective SameSite mode for testing.

methods.name: BuildCookieLine
methods.description: Builds a cookie header string from a list of cookies.

methods.name: BuildCookieAttributesLine
methods.description: Builds a cookie attribute string for HTTP headers.
